summary: A piecewise map, continuous on the open set Ω and constant off it.

steps.claim: A map into G₁(𝔰) is measurable when its matrix is; the matrix of gramSection(Z) is sectionMatrix(Z) on the open (hence measurable) set Ω, where it is continuous (being differentiable, differentiableAt_sectionMatrix), and the identity off Ω; such a piecewise map is measurable.
